question.stem:
Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =3x^3 +ax^2 \\ -(2b-11a)x -35\end{gathered}\], where \(a,b\) are constants. When \(f(x)\) is divided by \(3x^2-bx-1\), the remainder is \(-32\).
(a) Find \(a,b\).
(b) Find the remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(3x+5\).
(c) Edwin claims that all the roots of \(f(x)=0\) are rational. Do you agree? Explain.
question.stemZh:
設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =3x^3 +ax^2 \\ -(2b-11a)x -35\end{gathered}\]，其中 \(a,b\) 為常數。\(f(x)\) 被 \(3x^2-bx-1\) 除的餘式為 \(-32\)。
(a) 求 \(a,b\)。
(b) 求 \(f(x)\) 被 \(3x+5\) 除的餘式。
(c) Edwin 聲稱 \(f(x)=0\) 的所有根均為有理數。你同意嗎？解釋。
question.solution:
(a) Let the quotient be \(cx+d\). Comparing leading and constant coefficients gives \(c=1,d=3\). Then \(a=9-b\) and \(2b-11a=1+3b\). Solving gives \(a=-1,b=10\).
(b) Now \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =3x^3 -x^2 \\ -31x -35 \\ =(3x+5)(x^2-2x-7)\end{gathered}\]. Hence the remainder is \(f(-\frac53)=0\).
(c) The roots are \(-\frac53\) and \(1\pm2\sqrt2\). The latter two are irrational, so Edwin is incorrect.
question.solutionZh:
(a) 設商為 \(cx+d\)。比較首項及常數項得 \(c=1,d=3\)。再得 \(a=9-b\) 及 \(2b-11a=1+3b\)，解得 \(a=-1,b=10\)。
(b) 此時 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =3x^3 -x^2 \\ -31x -35 \\ =(3x+5)(x^2-2x-7)\end{gathered}\]。故餘式為 \(f(-\frac53)=0\)。
(c) 根為 \(-\frac53\) 及 \(1\pm2\sqrt2\)，後兩根是無理數，故不同意。

question.stem:
Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(2x-3)(3x^2+ax+b)\end{gathered}\], where \(a,b\) are constants. When \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x-2\), the remainder is \(5a+2\). When divided by \(x+1\), the remainder is \(-35\).
(a) Find \(a,b\).
(b) Someone claims that \(f(x)=6x-9\) has at least one irrational root. Do you agree? Explain.
question.stemZh:
設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(2x-3)(3x^2+ax+b)\end{gathered}\]，其中 \(a,b\) 為常數。\(f(x)\) 被 \(x-2\) 除的餘式為 \(5a+2\)，被 \(x+1\) 除的餘式為 \(-35\)。
(a) 求 \(a,b\)。
(b) 有人聲稱 \(f(x)=6x-9\) 至少有一個無理根。你同意嗎？解釋。
question.solution:
(a) \(f(2)=5a+2\) gives \(3a-b=10\); \(f(-1)=-35\) gives \(-a+b=4\). Hence \(a=7,b=11\).
(b) Move \(6x-9=3(2x-3)\) to the left and factor: \[\begin{gathered}(2x-3)(3x^2+7x+8) \\ =0\end{gathered}\]. The quadratic discriminant is \(49-96=-47<0\), so the only real root is the rational number \(\frac32\). There is no irrational root; disagree.

question.stem:
Let \(f(x)\) be a cubic polynomial. Its remainders on division by \(x+1\) and \(x-2\) are \(-5\) and \(148\) respectively. It is divisible by \(5x^2+7x+3\).
(a) Find the quotient when divided by \(5x^2+7x+3\).
(b) Peter claims that \(f(x)=0\) has 3 distinct real roots. Do you agree? Explain.
question.stemZh:
設 \(f(x)\) 為三次多項式，被 \(x+1\) 及 \(x-2\) 除的餘式分別為 \(-5\) 及 \(148\)，並可被 \(5x^2+7x+3\) 整除。
(a) 求它被 \(5x^2+7x+3\) 除的商。
(b) Peter 聲稱 \(f(x)=0\) 有 3 個相異實根。你同意嗎？解釋。
question.solution:
(a) Write \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(ax+b)(5x^2+7x+3)\end{gathered}\]. Substituting \(-1\) gives \(-a+b=-5\); substituting 2 gives \(2a+b=4\). Thus \(a=3,b=-2\) and the quotient is \(3x-2\).
(b) The quadratic discriminant is \[\begin{gathered}7^2 -4(5)(3) = \\ -11<0\end{gathered}\]. Only the linear factor gives a real root, \(x=\frac23\). There is exactly one real root, so disagree.
question.solutionZh:
(a) 設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(ax+b)(5x^2+7x+3)\end{gathered}\]。代入 \(-1\) 得 \(-a+b=-5\)，代入 2 得 \(2a+b=4\)。故 \(a=3,b=-2\)，商為 \(3x-2\)。
(b) 二次式的判別式為 \[\begin{gathered}7^2 -4(5)(3) = \\ -11<0\end{gathered}\]，只有一次因式給出實根 \(x=\frac23\)。因此恰有一個實根，故不同意。

question.stem:
A polynomial \(f(x)\) satisfies \(f(-2)=0\). When \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x^2+x-1\), the quotient is \(4x^2+x+4\) and the remainder is \(kx+k-5\).
(a) Find \(k\).
(b) Find \(f(-\frac14)\).
(c) Factorise \(f(x)\) completely.
question.solution:
(a) Use \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(x^2+x-1)(4x^2+x+4) \\ +kx +k -5\end{gathered}\]. At \(x=-2\), \(0=18-k-5\), giving \(k=13\).
(b) Substitute \(-\frac14\) into this identity to get \(f(-\frac14)=0\).
(c) The two known roots give factors \(x+2\) and \(4x+1\). Dividing the expanded polynomial \[\begin{gathered}4x^4 +5x^3 +x^2 \\ +16x +4\end{gathered}\] by these factors gives \(x^2-x+2\). Hence \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(x+2)(4x+1)\\ {}\cdot(x^2-x+2)\end{gathered}\]. The last factor has discriminant \(-7\), so has no real linear factors.
question.solutionZh:
(a) 由除法恆等式 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(x^2+x-1)(4x^2+x+4) \\ +kx +k -5\end{gathered}\]，代入 \(-2\) 得 \(0=18-k-5\)，故 \(k=13\)。
(b) 把 \(-\frac14\) 代入該恆等式，得 \(f(-\frac14)=0\)。
(c) 兩個已知根給出因式 \(x+2\) 及 \(4x+1\)。把展開式 \[\begin{gathered}4x^4 +5x^3 +x^2 \\ +16x +4\end{gathered}\] 除以兩因式得 \(x^2-x+2\)。故 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(x+2)(4x+1)\\ {}\cdot(x^2-x+2)\end{gathered}\]。最後的二次式判別式為 \(-7\)，不能再分解成實一次因式。

question.stem:
Let \(p(x)\) be a cubic polynomial. Its remainder on division by \(x^2+1\) is \(-x-5\). Its remainder on division by \(x+2\) is \(-3\), and it is divisible by \(x-1\).
(a) Find the quotient when \(p(x)\) is divided by \(x^2+1\).
(b) Someone claims that \(p(x)=0\) has at least one irrational root. Do you agree? Explain.
question.stemZh:
設 \(p(x)\) 為三次多項式，被 \(x^2+1\) 除的餘式為 \(-x-5\)，被 \(x+2\) 除的餘式為 \(-3\)，並可被 \(x-1\) 整除。
(a) 求它被 \(x^2+1\) 除的商。
(b) 有人聲稱 \(p(x)=0\) 至少有一個無理根。你同意嗎？解釋。
question.solution:
(a) Let \[\begin{gathered}p(x) =(ax+b)(x^2+1) \\ -x -5\end{gathered}\]. From \(p(-2)=-3\), \(-2a+b=0\); from \(p(1)=0\), \(a+b=3\). Hence \(a=1,b=2\) and the quotient is \(x+2\).
(b) \[\begin{gathered}p(x) =x^3 +2x^2 -3 \\ =(x-1)(x^2+3x+3)\end{gathered}\]. The quadratic discriminant is \(9-12=-3<0\). The only real root is 1, which is rational; disagree.
question.solutionZh:
(a) 設 \[\begin{gathered}p(x) =(ax+b)(x^2+1) \\ -x -5\end{gathered}\]。由 \(p(-2)=-3\) 得 \(-2a+b=0\)，由 \(p(1)=0\) 得 \(a+b=3\)。故 \(a=1,b=2\)，商為 \(x+2\)。
(b) \[\begin{gathered}p(x) =x^3 +2x^2 -3 \\ =(x-1)(x^2+3x+3)\end{gathered}\]。二次式判別式為 \(9-12=-3<0\)，唯一實根為有理數 1，故不同意。

question.stem:
A cubic polynomial \(f(x)\) has quotient \(2(3x+5)\) when divided by \(x^2-1\). It satisfies \(f(2)=88\), and its remainder on division by \(x-1\) is 15.
(a) Find \(f(x)\).
(b) Prove that \(3x+2\) is a factor of \(f(x)\).
(c) How many rational roots does \(f(x)=0\) have? Explain.
question.solution:
(a) Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =2(3x+5)(x^2-1) +ax \\ +b\end{gathered}\]. Since \(f(1)=15\) and \(f(2)=88\), \(a+b=15\) and \(2a+b=22\). Thus \(a=7,b=8\) and \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =6x^3 +10x^2 \\ +x -2\end{gathered}\].
(b) Substituting \(x=-\frac23\) gives zero, so \(3x+2\) is a factor.

question.stem:
Let \[\begin{gathered}g(x) =x^3 +3x^2 \\ +(r-4)x -r\end{gathered}\], where \(r\) is an integer.
(a) Is \(x-1\) a factor of \(g(x)\)? Explain.
(b) Factorise \(g(x)\).
(c) A student claims that exactly two values of \(r\) make \(g(x)=0\) have exactly two distinct real roots. Do you agree? Explain.
question.stemZh:
設 \[\begin{gathered}g(x) =x^3 +3x^2 \\ +(r-4)x -r\end{gathered}\]，其中 \(r\) 為整數。
(a) \(x-1\) 是否 \(g(x)\) 的因式？解釋。
(b) 把 \(g(x)\) 因式分解。
(c) 學生聲稱恰有兩個 \(r\) 值令 \(g(x)=0\) 恰有兩個相異實根。你同意嗎？解釋。
question.solution:
(a) \[\begin{gathered}g(1) =1 +3 +r -4 -r \\ =0\end{gathered}\], so yes.
(b) Division gives \[\begin{gathered}g(x) \\ =(x-1)(x^2+4x+r)\end{gathered}\].
(c) Two possibilities exhaust exactly two distinct real roots. First the quadratic has a repeated root other than 1: \(16-4r=0\), giving \(r=4\) and roots \(1,-2\). Second it has two distinct roots, one equal to 1: \(1+4+r=0\), giving \(r=-5\) and \(g(x)=(x-1)^2(x+5)\).
For \(r>4\) only the root 1 is real; for \(r<4\) other than \(-5\) there are three distinct real roots. Thus precisely \(r=4,-5\) work; agree.
question.solutionZh:
(a) \[\begin{gathered}g(1) =1 +3 +r -4 -r \\ =0\end{gathered}\]，所以是因式。
(b) 相除得 \[\begin{gathered}g(x) \\ =(x-1)(x^2+4x+r)\end{gathered}\]。
(c) 恰有兩個相異實根有且只有兩種可能：二次式有異於 1 的重根，則 \(16-4r=0\)，得 \(r=4\)，根為 \(1,-2\)；或二次式有兩個相異實根且其中一根是 1，則 \(1+4+r=0\)，得 \(r=-5\)，此時 \(g(x)=(x-1)^2(x+5)\)。
若 \(r>4\)，只有實根 1；若 \(r<4\) 且 \(r\ne-5\)，有三個相異實根。因此恰有 \(r=4,-5\) 兩值可行，故同意。

question.stem:
Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =x^3 -x^2 +ax \\ +b\end{gathered}\]. It is divisible by \(x-1\), and its remainder on division by \(x-2\) is \(-4\).
(a) Find \(a,b\).
(b) Solve \(f(x)+4=0\).
question.stemZh:
設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =x^3 -x^2 +ax \\ +b\end{gathered}\]。它可被 \(x-1\) 整除，被 \(x-2\) 除的餘式為 \(-4\)。
(a) 求 \(a,b\)。
(b) 解 \(f(x)+4=0\)。
question.solution:
(a) \(f(1)=0\) gives \(a+b=0\); \(f(2)=-4\) gives \(2a+b=-8\). Hence \(a=-8,b=8\).
(b) \[\begin{gathered}f(x) +4 =x^3 -x^2 \\ -8x +12 \\ =(x-2)(x^2+x-6) \\ =(x-2)^2(x+3)\end{gathered}\]. Thus \(x=2\) or \(x=-3\); 2 is a repeated root.

question.stem:
A polynomial \(f(x)\) is divisible by \((x-1)(x-4)\). When it is divided by \((x-1)^2\), the quotient is \(g(x)\) and the remainder is \(3x+k\), where \(k\) is a constant.
(a) Find \(k\).
(b) A student claims that \(g(x)+1=0\) has at least one real root. Do you agree? Explain.
question.stemZh:
多項式 \(f(x)\) 可被 \((x-1)(x-4)\) 整除。它被 \((x-1)^2\) 除的商為 \(g(x)\)，餘式為 \(3x+k\)，其中 \(k\) 為常數。
(a) 求 \(k\)。
(b) 學生聲稱 \(g(x)+1=0\) 至少有一個實根。你同意嗎？解釋。
question.solution:
(a) \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =(x-1)^2g(x) \\ +3x +k\end{gathered}\]. Since \(f(1)=0\), \(3+k=0\), so \(k=-3\).
(b) Since \(f(4)=0\), \(9g(4)+12-3=0\), giving \(g(4)=-1\). Hence \(x=4\) is a real root of \(g(x)+1=0\); agree.
question.sourceZh: S4/more about polynomials/POLYNOMIALS REVIEWS 6.pdf · 第9題

question.stem: Let \(f(x)=3x^3-4x+k\). If \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(x-k\), find the remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x+k\).
question.stemZh: 設 \(f(x)=3x^3-4x+k\)。若 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(x-k\) 整除，求它被 \(x+k\) 除的餘式。
question.solution: From \(f(k)=0\), \(3k^3-3k=0\), hence \(k^3=k\). The required remainder is \[\begin{gathered}f(-k) = -3k^3 +5k \\ =2k\end{gathered}\]. This also holds when \(k=0\); do not divide by \(k\).
question.solutionZh: 由 \(f(k)=0\) 得 \(3k^3-3k=0\)，故 \(k^3=k\)。所求餘式為 \[\begin{gathered}f(-k) = -3k^3 +5k \\ =2k\end{gathered}\]。\(k=0\) 時亦成立，不可直接除以 \(k\)。
question.sourceZh: S4/more about polynomials/POLYNOMIALS REVIEWS 6.pdf · 第15題

question.stem: Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =(x+3)(x^2-11) \\ +k\end{gathered}\], where \(k\) is a constant. If \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(x-3\), find its remainder on division by \(x+2\).
question.stemZh: 設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =(x+3)(x^2-11) \\ +k\end{gathered}\]，其中 \(k\) 為常數。若 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(x-3\) 整除，求它被 \(x+2\) 除的餘式。
question.solution: From \(f(3)=6(9-11)+k=0\), \(k=12\). The required remainder is \[\begin{gathered}f(-2) =1(4-11) +12 \\ =5\end{gathered}\].
question.sourceZh: S4/more about polynomials/POLYNOMIALS REVIEWS 6.pdf · 第16題

question.stem: Find the H.C.F. of \(x^2y^3z\), \(x^8y^3z^3\) and \(x^8y^6z^3\).
question.solution: Take the minimum powers of each variable: \(x^2\), \(y^3\) and \(z\). Thus the H.C.F. is \(x^2y^3z\).

question.stem: Let \(g(x)=3x^2-bx+10\), where \(b\) is a constant. Its remainder on division by \(x-2\) is 12. Find its remainder on division by \(3x-8\).
question.stemZh: 設 \(g(x)=3x^2-bx+10\)，其中 \(b\) 為常數。它被 \(x-2\) 除的餘式為 12，求它被 \(3x-8\) 除的餘式。
question.solution: Use \(g(2)=12\): \(12-2b+10=12\), hence \(b=5\). The required remainder is \[\begin{gathered}g(8/3) =64/3 -40/3 \\ +10 =18\end{gathered}\].
question.sourceZh: S4/more about polynomials/POLYNOMIALS REVIEWS 6.pdf · 第18題

question.stem: Find the L.C.M. of \(2m^2n\), \(4m^3n\) and \(12mn^2\).

question.solutionZh: 係數最小公倍數為 12；變量最高次冪為 \(m^3,n^2\)，故最小公倍式為 \(12m^3n^2\)。

question.stem: Let \(k\) be a constant such that \(2x^4-kx^3-2x+4\) is divisible by \(2x-k\). Find \(k\).
question.solution: Write the polynomial as \(x^3(2x-k)-2x+4\). At \(x=k/2\), the remainder is \(-k+4\), so divisibility requires \(k=4\).
